g.text: F08 Browser language preferences and scripted modifications
Seven saved cases · T = alarm, F = no alarm · model cells also show evaluation role
First-language differences occur in both normal preferences and scripted modifications.
P0 saved branch (C1 = F, C2 = T): Browser list length ≤ 2.5 → T; > 2.5 → F.
P0 distinguishes these recipes; P1 and P2 alarm on both normal preference cases.
train = in sample; heldout = whole-batch development holdout of previously seen material.
P1: matched train / pilot heldout. P2: pilot train / matched heldout. No general length rule.
